R-hierarchy.reason: The $1,284.50 of $2,000 spending hero and wavy progress bar lead clearly at the top, followed by the Add expense action, category cards, and recent transactions without competing elements.

R-fill.reason: Only the single primary Add expense button uses a strong saturated fill while cards, transaction rows, and secondary containers stay neutral or softly tinted.

R-surfaces.reason: Calm tinted neutral surfaces separate the backdrop, category cards, segmented transaction rows, and desktop Log expense panel with clear tonal grouping.

R-controls.reason: Buttons, clickable category cards, filter chips, segmented transaction rows, and navigation items all read as distinct tappable controls, with Cancel paired beside Add expense in the form.

R-font.reason: Fraunces gives clear editorial character to the Pocket header, $1,284.50 display figure, and Log expense title, while labels stay Google Sans Flex and numbers use Google Sans Code.

R-platform.reason: The layout uses Android Material 3 navigation, edge-to-edge drawing, and clean rows without iOS disclosure chevrons or top-bar Cancel/Done actions.

R-text.reason: All text is sharp, unclipped, and non-overlapping across all five renders, with bottom-edge cutoffs occurring only at natural scrolling list boundaries.

R-dark.reason: In home-dark.png, all headings, currency values, category icons, filter chips, transaction rows, and bottom navigation items are crisp and clearly legible against dark surfaces.

R-adaptive.reason: Navigation moves from a bottom bar on phone to a collapsed rail on foldable and tablet and an expanded rail on desktop, progressively revealing a two-pane list layout on tablet and a three-pane layout with a persistent Log expense panel on desktop.

R-idea.reason: The Editorial Ledger concept pairs Fraunces display typography, tabular Google Sans Code amounts, a wavy budget progress bar, and a three-pane desktop ledger workspace specific to expense tracking.

R-semantics.reason: Section titles (Spent this month, By category, Recent transactions, and Log expense) carry Modifier.semantics { heading() }, FilterChips are single controls, and there are no Switch/Checkbox/RadioButton rows.

R-fields.reason: Both OutlinedTextFields in AddExpenseForm use state = rememberTextFieldState() rather than value/onValueChange overloads, with no password fields.

R-visibility.reason: All conditional navigation bars, expanded panes, CTA buttons, sheets, dialogs, and error texts are gated with if statements so hidden UI leaves composition.

R-blur.reason: No Modifier.blur is used anywhere in the proposal.

R-finance-categories.reason: In RecentTransactionsSection, all transaction list badges render in uniform gray (surfaceContainerHighest) instead of keeping each category's badge color from the By category cards, and the four category card badges (Home primaryContainer, Transport secondaryContainer, Food tertiaryContainer, Fun surfaceContainerHighest) are not all distinguishable by hue.
